Reading the atlas

Mercury Life Atlas explores ten dimensions within the Mercury Mahadasha, not an entire lifetime. These are interpretive Jyotish ratings, not probabilities or deterministic forecasts.

Color represents domain support: green for leverage, yellow for mixed conditions, and orange/red for lower support or greater caution. Intensity is a separate measure, shown as 1–4 bars on SD cells and as a named category in details. Spiritual leverage means inner-development potential and can accompany difficult external circumstances. Mind describes clarity and emotional load; Vitality describes energy and stress burden. Neither is a diagnosis. Reinvention measures constructive change capacity, not comfort.

The Timeline shows all nine ADs. Each row spans its own dates, and its PD segments have duration-proportional widths. Vertically aligned positions are not the same calendar date. Tap a rating in the legend to filter; tap a PD to open its details. Inspect lets you press and slide for a preview. Pinch or use +/− to zoom, drag to pan, and use the minimap to jump.

The Life map compares ten dimensions across nine PDs or SDs. Its columns are equal-width for readability. A dimension selector recolors the main timeline without changing the dates.

Calculation approach · v4 PD-dominant hierarchy

Support is comparative within Mercury Mahadasha. In v4, AD supplies climate, PD is the dominant operational theme, and SD is a short-term modifier. All ten dimensions use revised D1 and divisional-chart planet profiles, centered by subtracting that dimension’s nine-planet mean. Intensity is separate from support.

PD baseline: 10% centered Mercury MD + 24% centered AD + 66% centered PD + 45% AD–PD interaction. This excludes SD and transit effects; it is not a child-period average.

SD dasha signal: parent baseline + 18% centered SD + 30% PD–SD interaction + 8% AD–SD interaction. Add slow transits (capped at ±0.65), exact conjunction/opposition contacts (capped at ±0.55), and a light fast SD-lord house modifier. Moon’s fast modifier is halved; Jupiter, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu have no fast modifier.

Transit context: the supplied midpoint snapshots use Lahiri with true Rahu/Ketu nodes. Mind also incorporates houses from the Libra Moon alongside Scorpio Lagna. Evidence shows both reference houses and the supplied longitude.

Support buckets: raw ≥0.78 → 1; ≥0.22 → 2; >−0.22 → 3; >−0.78 → 4; otherwise 5. SD heat is normally restricted to one band from its PD baseline. Two bands are permitted only when the absolute short-term adjustment (SD profile and interactions + slow transit + exact contacts + fast SD-lord transit) is at least 0.62. Then ++ requires a dasha signal ≥0.95, or dasha ≥0.48 with combined transit evidence ≥0.08; otherwise it becomes +. Likewise −− requires dasha ≤−0.95, or dasha ≤−0.48 with transit evidence ≤−0.08; otherwise it becomes −. This additional rule applies to final SD ratings.

Intensity: 20% AD + 35% PD + 45% SD volatility plus pair and contact boosts, capped at 1.35. Low is below 0.42; medium starts at 0.42; high at 0.72; very high at 1.00. The generic transit-tone label is a separate descriptor.

SD support index = raw / 1.35, clamped to −1…+1, × 100 and rounded. Parent index uses the baseline divided by 1.10 on the same −100…+100 display scale; the two indices use different normalization. The index precedes heat caps and convergence checks, so it does not uniquely determine the final color. These are interpretive categories, not probabilities.

V4 retains all 729 period boundaries and the audited v3 true-node transit positions, contacts and summaries. Midpoint gochara is a snapshot, not a complete account of transits across the period; slow planets and exact contacts carry more weight than fast-planet midpoint positions. This app evaluates the supplied model offline and does not recalculate ephemerides or independently repeat the source’s astronomical audit.

Audit history & v4 hierarchy correction

Audit retained: the v4 source retains the v3 timing, divisional-chart and true-node ephemeris foundation, including the reported Open Ephemeris spot-checks. The app imports that supplied data; it does not independently repeat the astronomical audit.

Hierarchy correction: the source reduces AD and AD–PD interaction influence so the PD is the dominant operational layer. Its Venus AD → Mercury PD → Mercury SD Career example now has a + Leverage parent (+23), + Leverage composite (+32), and low intensity.

V4 sensitivity reported by the source: across three PD-dominant weighting schemes and 7,290 dimension-period cells, 81.9% of ratings were identical and 100% stayed within one heat band. This reported sensitivity comparison is not empirical predictive accuracy. Read borderline cells as adjacent bands.

Divisional-chart anchors

Chart-specific context supplied with the model. The numerical model uses the planet profiles below; it does not calculate divisional charts at runtime.

Wealth — D2 Hora Strict Parāśarī Hora: Cancer Lagna; Sun/Moon/Venus/Jupiter/Rahu/Ketu in Cancer, Mercury/Mars/Saturn in Leo. Used as Hora condition alongside D1 2/5/9/11—not as a conventional 12-house D2.
Family / Home — D4 + D12 support D4 Aquarius Lagna: Mercury 1H, Sun 10H, Mars/Saturn 5H, Ketu 8H. D12 Aquarius Lagna is used secondarily for parental/ancestral load. Read with D1 2nd/4th and Moon.
Children / Legacy — D7 Cancer Lagna; Moon/Jupiter 7H, Mercury 9H, Venus 4H, Rahu 6H, Ketu 12H. Read with D1 5th/Jupiter.
Marriage / Partnership — D9 Virgo Lagna; Moon 7H, Venus Taurus 9H, Saturn 1H, Sun 10H. Read with D1 7th/Venus.
Career / Authority — D10 Libra Lagna; Saturn/Rahu 5H, Mercury 7H, Moon/Jupiter 6H, Ketu 11H. Career is scored from D1 + D10 + the PD-dominant hierarchy + transit/contact overlays. Stored legacy career heat is not used.
Spiritual — D20 Gemini Lagna; Jupiter/Saturn 9H, Moon 10H, Mercury 11H, Venus/Rahu/Ketu 8H. Used for sādhana/inner-development potential.
Learning — D24 Aquarius Lagna; Venus 5H, Jupiter 7H, Saturn 3H, Mercury/Mars 12H, Moon 8H. Read with D1 Mercury/Jupiter/4th/5th/9th.
Mind / Vitality Primarily D1 Lagna, Moon, Mercury, 4th/5th for Mind and Lagna/Sun/Mars plus 6/8/12 for Vitality. Slow transits carry extra weight.
Reinvention / Autonomy Primarily D1 1/8/10/11/12, Mercury, Mars and the nodes, with Jupiter/Saturn/Rahu/Ketu transits. This measures constructive change capacity, not comfort.
